widgets_values:
## The skeleton cannot see a small head turn.

DWPose at 512 pixels draws the head facing the camera even when the photo is only slightly turned and the eyes look left. The pose LoRA follows that drawing, and a text caption cannot override it.

EXPRESSION PASS ignores the pose LoRA. It redraws only the new face, using the reference photo itself as the guide for head angle and eye direction. If the eyes are still too frontal, raise denoise on EXPRESSION PASS. If the face becomes the reference person, lower it.

POSE FROM REFERENCE resolution is 1024 so the body skeleton is less likely to snap frontal.
